question: What primordial knowledge and identity with Vedic revelation characterize the being?
premises: The being is the primeval knower
The being is maker of the Veda
The being is the self of the Veda and ocean of scripture
inference: The being is the source, essence, and vast repository of Vedic knowledge.
plain_english: He is the primeval knower, maker of the Veda, the very self of the Veda, and an ocean of scripture.
